```{r plot-dist}
                           "Mn" = "ln(Mn)",
                           "Pb" = "ln(Pb)",

                           "Zn" = "ln(Zn)")

elements_nonessential <- c("As", "Cd", "Hg", "Pb", "V")

dat_box <- dat_p %>%

box_el_plot <- function(el, bottom, x_lab = NULL) {
  dat_box %>%
    filter(element == paste0("ln(", el, ")")) %>%
    ggplot() +
    geom_point(aes(x = source, y = log_conc,
                   col = BDT, alpha = BDT),
               position = position_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, seed = 42),
               show.legend = TRUE) +
    geom_boxplot(linewidth = 0.75,
                 aes(x = source, y = log_conc),
                 fill = NA) +
    facet_wrap(~ element, strip.position = "left") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("black", "red"), drop = FALSE) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c(0.25, 0.5), drop = FALSE) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(strip.placement = "outside",
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          text = element_text(size = 30),
          axis.text.x = if (bottom) element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1)
                        else element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = if (bottom) element_line() else element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(5, 15, 5, 15)) +
    guides(col = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3)),
           alpha = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3))) +
    labs(x = x_lab,
         y = NULL,
         col = "Censored (< LOQ)",
         alpha = "Censored (< LOQ)")
}

box_group_label <- function(txt, base_size = 30) {
  ggplot() +
    annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = txt, size = base_size * 0.8 / .pt) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1), expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
          plot.margin = margin(5, 15, 5, 15))
}
```

```{r brm-TE}
brm_dat <- dat_all %>%
  filter_out(element == "Tl") %>%
  filter_out(element == "Co" & conc > 500) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor)) %>%
  mutate(source = fct_relevel(source, "Iceland", after = 5)) %>%
  mutate(element = factor(element),
         source = factor(source, levels = c("Kent", "Country", "Middle_lawn",
                                            "Gull", "Baccalieu", "Iceland")),
         source = fct_recode(source, `Middle Lawn` = "Middle_lawn"),
         cens_ind = if_else(BDT, "left", "none"))

write_rds(brm_dat, "../output/brm_dat.rds")

priors_te <- prior(normal(0, 2), class = "b")

elements_te <- levels(brm_dat$element)

m_elem <- list()

for (el in elements_te) {

  dat_el <- brm_dat %>%
    filter(element == el)

  m_elem[[el]] <- brm(bf(log(conc) | cens(cens_ind) ~ source),
                       data = dat_el,
                       seed = 42,
                       iter = 4000,
                       cores = 6,
                       chains = 6,
                       family = student,
                       prior = priors_te,
                       file = paste0("../models/bm_TE_", el, ".rds"),
                       file_refit = "on_change",
                       silent = 2,
                       save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE))
}
```

```{r prior-pred-TE}
set.seed(42)
n_prior_draws <- 2000

prior_pred_draws_te <- elements_te %>%
  map(function(el) {

    dat_el <- brm_dat %>% filter(element == el)
    log_conc <- log(dat_el$conc)
    mu0 <- median(log_conc)
    s0 <- mad(log_conc)

    colonies <- levels(dat_el$source)
    non_ref <- colonies[-1]

    intercept_draws <- mu0 + s0 * rt(n_prior_draws, df = 3)
    b_draws <- non_ref %>%
      map(~ rnorm(n_prior_draws, 0, 2)) %>%
      set_names(non_ref) %>%
      as_tibble()
    sigma_draws <- abs(2.5 * rt(n_prior_draws, df = 3))
    nu_draws <- pmax(rgamma(n_prior_draws, 2, 0.1), 1)

    sim_conc <- colonies %>%
      map(function(col) {
        loc <- if (col == colonies[1]) intercept_draws else intercept_draws + b_draws[[col]]
        log_sim <- loc + sigma_draws * rt(n_prior_draws, df = nu_draws)
        exp(log_sim)
      }) %>%
      unlist()

    tibble(element = el, sim_conc = sim_conc)
  }) %>%
  list_rbind()

prior_pred_te <- prior_pred_draws_te %>%
  group_by(element) %>%
  summarise(prior_pred_q025 = quantile(sim_conc, 0.025),
            prior_pred_median = quantile(sim_conc, 0.5),
            prior_pred_q975 = quantile(sim_conc, 0.975)) %>%
  left_join(brm_dat %>%
              group_by(element) %>%
              summarise(obs_min = min(conc), obs_max = max(conc)),
            by = "element")

prior_pred_te

write_csv(prior_pred_te, "../output/prior_pred_te.csv")
```

```{r prior-pred-TE-plot}

  mutate(log_conc = log(sim_conc),
         element = factor(element, levels = elements_te_tab)) %>%
  group_by(element) %>%
  filter(log_conc >= quantile(log_conc, 0.005, na.rm = TRUE),
```

```{r diag-TE}
set.seed(42)

# Convergence diagnostics per element
diag_te <- elements_te %>%
  map(function(el) {
    m <- m_elem[[el]]
    tibble(element = el,
           max_rhat = max(brms::rhat(m)),
           n_divergent = sum(subset(nuts_params(m), Parameter == "divergent__")$Value),
           n_draws = ndraws(m),
           bayes_R2 = bayes_R2(m)[1, "Estimate"])
  }) %>%
  list_rbind()

diag_te

write_csv(diag_te, "../output/diag_te.csv")

loo_te <- elements_te %>%
  map(function(el) {
    m <- m_elem[[el]]
    l <- loo(m)
    k_before <- l$diagnostics$pareto_k
    l_mm <- loo_moment_match(m, l)
    k_after <- l_mm$diagnostics$pareto_k
    tibble(element = el,
           n_k07_before = sum(k_before > 0.7),
           max_k_before = max(k_before),
           n_k07_after = sum(k_after > 0.7),
           max_k_after = max(k_after))
  }) %>%
  list_rbind()

loo_te

write_csv(loo_te, "../output/loo_te.csv")
```

```{r ppc-stat-TE}
# Posterior predictive checks targeting distributional shape and spread using skewness and IQR
set.seed(42)

row_skewness <- function(m) {
  xc <- m - rowMeans(m)
  rowMeans(xc^3) / (rowMeans(xc^2))^(3/2)
}

skewness <- function(x) {
  xc <- x - mean(x)
  mean(xc^3) / mean(xc^2)^(3/2)
}

conc_rep_te <- elements_te %>%
  map(function(el) exp(posterior_predict(m_elem[[el]]))) %>%
  set_names(elements_te)

skew_obs_te <- elements_te %>%
  map_dbl(~ row_skewness(matrix((brm_dat %>% filter(element == .x))$conc, nrow = 1))) %>%
  set_names(elements_te)
skew_rep_te <- elements_te %>%
  map(~ row_skewness(conc_rep_te[[.x]])) %>%
  set_names(elements_te)

ppc_stat_te <- elements_te %>%
  map(function(el) {
    conc_obs <- (brm_dat %>% filter(element == el))$conc
    conc_rep <- conc_rep_te[[el]]

    skew_obs <- skew_obs_te[[el]]
    skew_rep <- skew_rep_te[[el]]
    iqr_obs <- IQR(conc_obs)
    iqr_rep <- apply(conc_rep, 1, IQR)

    tibble(element = el,
           stat = c("skewness", "IQR"),
           T_obs = c(skew_obs, iqr_obs),
           bayesian_p = c(mean(skew_rep > skew_obs, na.rm = TRUE),
                          mean(iqr_rep > iqr_obs, na.rm = TRUE)),
           n_excluded_nonfinite = c(sum(!is.finite(skew_rep)), sum(!is.finite(iqr_rep))))
  }) %>%
  list_rbind()

ppc_stat_te

write_csv(ppc_stat_te, "../output/ppc_stat_te.csv")

# IQR check figures
for (el in elements_te) {
  conc_obs <- (brm_dat %>% filter(element == el))$conc
  conc_rep <- conc_rep_te[[el]]

  p_iqr <- ppc_stat(y = conc_obs, yrep = conc_rep, stat = "IQR") + ggtitle(paste(el, "- IQR"))

  # ggsave(paste0("../figures/ppc_stat_", el, "_IQR.png"), p_iqr,

}
```

```{r emm-TE}
# Pairwise colony contrasts per element, plus back-transformed effect sizes.
em_col <- elements_te %>%
  map(function(el) {
    as.data.frame(emmeans(m_elem[[el]], pairwise ~ source)$contrasts) %>%
      mutate(element = el)
  }) %>%
  list_rbind()

em_col <- em_col %>%
  mutate(sig = case_when(lower.QL <= 0 & upper.QL >= 0 ~ 0,
                         TRUE ~ 1),
         ratio = exp(estimate),
         ratio_lower = exp(lower.QL),
         ratio_upper = exp(upper.QL),
         pct_change = (ratio - 1) * 100,
         pct_change_lower = (ratio_lower - 1) * 100,
         pct_change_upper = (ratio_upper - 1) * 100)

write_csv(em_col, "../output/emmeans_contr.csv")

em_col %>%
  group_by(element) %>%
  summarise(sig = sum(sig))
```

```{r emm-TE-heatmap}
emm_heat_plot <- function(els, base_size, text_size, show_x = TRUE) {
  em_col %>%
    filter(element %in% els) %>%
    separate_wider_delim(contrast, delim = " - ", names = c("col1", "col2")) %>%
    group_by(col1, col2) %>%
    summarise(total = sum(sig), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(prop = total / length(els),
           col1 = factor(col1, levels = c("Kent", "Country", "Middle Lawn",
                                          "Gull", "Baccalieu", "Iceland")),
           col2 = factor(col2, levels = c("Kent", "Country", "Middle Lawn",
                                          "Gull", "Baccalieu", "Iceland"))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = col1, y = col2, fill = prop)) +
    geom_tile(col = "black", alpha = 0.75) +
    geom_text(aes(label = total),
              size = text_size) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#C6DBEF", high = "#084594",
                        limits = c(0, 1), breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
                        labels = scales::percent) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
    coord_equal() +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = base_size),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.title = element_text(size = 20),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
          axis.text.x = if (!show_x) element_blank()
                        else if (base_size < 20) element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
                        else element_text(),
          axis.ticks.x = if (show_x) element_line() else element_blank()) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(title.position = "top",
                               nrow = 1)) +
    labs(x = NULL,
         y = NULL,
         fill = "Trace elements different")
}

emm_heat_title <- theme(
  plot.title.position = "panel",
  plot.title = ggtext::element_textbox_simple(
    size = 14, halign = 0.5,
    box.colour = "black", linetype = 1, linewidth = 0.5, r = unit(0, "pt"),
    padding = margin(4, 0, 4, 0), margin = margin(0, 0, 6, 0)))

EMM_col_p <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
  A = emm_heat_plot(elements_te_tab, base_size = 20, text_size = 8),
  B = emm_heat_plot(elements_essential, base_size = 14, text_size = 5,
                    show_x = FALSE) +
    ggtitle("Essential") + emm_heat_title,
  C = emm_heat_plot(elements_nonessential, base_size = 14, text_size = 5) +
    ggtitle("Non-essential") + emm_heat_title,
  design = "AAB\nAAC",
  guides = "collect"
) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

EMM_col_p

ggsave("../figures/EMM_col.png", plot = EMM_col_p,
       width = 35, height = 25, unit = "cm", dpi = 500)
```

```{r eppd-TE}
el_rect <- data.frame(element = factor(elements_te_tab, levels = elements_te_tab))
el_fill <- setNames(rep(c("#F7FBFF", "#08306B"), length.out = length(elements_te_tab)),
                    elements_te_tab)

eppd_group_plot <- function(els, y_lab = NULL) {
  brm_dat_p %>%
    filter(element %in% els) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = source, y = epred_conc)) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 0, ymax = Inf, fill = element),
              data = filter(el_rect, element %in% els), alpha = 0.05, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    stat_pointinterval(aes(color = source),
                       position = position_dodge(width = 0.85),
                       point_size = 3, .width = c(0.66, 0.95)) +
    facet_wrap(~ element, scales = "free_y",
               strip.position = "bottom", nrow = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = brewer.pal(9, "Blues")[-c(1:3)]) +
    scale_fill_manual(guide = "none", values = el_fill) +
    scale_y_log10() +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 26),
          strip.placement = "outside",
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "cm"),
          legend.margin = margin(t = 0, b = 0),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 2, b = 2, l = 5, r = 5),
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey25"),
          axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 5)),
          axis.line.y = element_line(color = "grey75"),
          axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "grey75"),
          axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black"),
```

```{r ppc-stat-TE-year-sensitivity}
# Same skewness + IQR checks

  map(function(el) exp(posterior_predict(m_elem_yr[[el]]))) %>%
  set_names(elements_te_yr)

    tibble(element = el,
           stat = c("skewness", "IQR"),
           T_obs = c(skew_obs, iqr_obs),
           bayesian_p = c(mean(skew_rep > skew_obs, na.rm = TRUE),
                          mean(iqr_rep > iqr_obs, na.rm = TRUE)),
           n_excluded_nonfinite = c(sum(!is.finite(skew_rep)), sum(!is.finite(iqr_rep))))
  }) %>%
  list_rbind()
```

```{r prior-pred-SI}
# Prior predictive check 
set.seed(42)

mu0_d13C <- median(brm_dat_si$d13C)
s0_d13C <- mad(brm_dat_si$d13C)
mu0_d15N <- median(brm_dat_si$d15N)
s0_d15N <- mad(brm_dat_si$d15N)

colonies_si <- levels(brm_dat_si$source)
non_ref_si <- colonies_si[-1]

intercept_d13C_draws <- mu0_d13C + s0_d13C * rt(n_prior_draws, df = 3)
intercept_d15N_draws <- mu0_d15N + s0_d15N * rt(n_prior_draws, df = 3)

b_d13C_draws <- non_ref_si %>%
  map(~ rnorm(n_prior_draws, 0, 3)) %>%
  set_names(non_ref_si) %>%
  as_tibble()
b_d15N_draws <- non_ref_si %>%
  map(~ rnorm(n_prior_draws, 0, 3)) %>%
  set_names(non_ref_si) %>%
  as_tibble()

sigma_d13C_draws <- abs(2.5 * rt(n_prior_draws, df = 3))
sigma_d15N_draws <- abs(2.5 * rt(n_prior_draws, df = 3))
nu_draws_si <- pmax(rgamma(n_prior_draws, 2, 0.1), 1)
rescor_draws <- runif(n_prior_draws, -1, 1)

prior_pred_draws_si <- colonies_si %>%
  map(function(col) {
    mu_d13C <- if (col == colonies_si[1]) intercept_d13C_draws else intercept_d13C_draws + b_d13C_draws[[col]]
    mu_d15N <- if (col == colonies_si[1]) intercept_d15N_draws else intercept_d15N_draws + b_d15N_draws[[col]]

    1:n_prior_draws %>%
      map(function(i) {
        Sigma <- matrix(c(sigma_d13C_draws[i]^2,
                          rescor_draws[i] * sigma_d13C_draws[i] * sigma_d15N_draws[i],
                          rescor_draws[i] * sigma_d13C_draws[i] * sigma_d15N_draws[i],
                          sigma_d15N_draws[i]^2), 2, 2)
        z <- rmvnorm(1, sigma = Sigma)
        w <- rchisq(1, df = nu_draws_si[i])
        tvec <- c(mu_d13C[i], mu_d15N[i]) + z / sqrt(w / nu_draws_si[i])
        tibble(d13C = tvec[1], d15N = tvec[2])
      }) %>%
      list_rbind() %>%
      mutate(source = col)
  }) %>%
  list_rbind()

prior_pred_si <- prior_pred_draws_si %>%
  pivot_longer(c(d13C, d15N), names_to = "isotope", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(isotope) %>%
  summarise(prior_pred_q025 = quantile(value, 0.025),
            prior_pred_median = quantile(value, 0.5),
            prior_pred_q975 = quantile(value, 0.975)) %>%
  left_join(brm_dat_si %>%
              pivot_longer(c(d13C, d15N), names_to = "isotope", values_to = "value") %>%
              group_by(isotope) %>%
              summarise(obs_min = min(value), obs_max = max(value)),
            by = "isotope")

prior_pred_si

write_csv(prior_pred_si, "../output/prior_pred_si.csv")
```

```{r model-diagnostics-table}
# Consolidated supplementary diagnostics table for the main models (9 TE + SI)
full_model_diagnostics <- function(m, label) {
  pars <- names(brms::rhat(m))
  pars <- pars[!pars %in% c("lp__", "lprior")]
  draws <- as_draws_array(m, variable = pars)
  summ <- summarise_draws(draws, "rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail") %>%
    filter(!is.na(rhat))

  np <- nuts_params(m)
  n_div <- sum(subset(np, Parameter == "divergent__")$Value)
  treedepth <- subset(np, Parameter == "treedepth__")$Value
  td_limit <- m$fit@stan_args[[1]]$control$max_treedepth
  if (is.null(td_limit)) td_limit <- 10
  ebfmi <- tryCatch(rstan::get_bfmi(m$fit), error = function(e) NA)

  l <- loo(m)
  k_before <- l$diagnostics$pareto_k
  n_k07_before <- sum(k_before > 0.7)
  max_k_before <- max(k_before)
  if (n_k07_before > 0) {
    l_mm <- loo_moment_match(m, l)
    k_after <- l_mm$diagnostics$pareto_k
    n_k07_after <- sum(k_after > 0.7)
    max_k_after <- max(k_after)
  } else {
    n_k07_after <- n_k07_before
    max_k_after <- max_k_before
  }

  tibble(model = label,
         min_rhat = min(summ$rhat), max_rhat = max(summ$rhat),
         min_ess_bulk = round(min(summ$ess_bulk)), max_ess_bulk = round(max(summ$ess_bulk)),
         min_ess_tail = round(min(summ$ess_tail)), max_ess_tail = round(max(summ$ess_tail)),
         n_divergent = n_div,
         max_treedepth = max(treedepth), treedepth_limit = td_limit,
         min_ebfmi = round(min(ebfmi, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
         max_pareto_k = round(max_k_before, 3), n_pareto_k_gt_0.7 = n_k07_before,
         max_pareto_k_after_mm = round(max_k_after, 3), n_pareto_k_gt_0.7_after_mm = n_k07_after)
}

model_diagnostics_main <- elements_te %>%
  map(~ full_model_diagnostics(m_elem[[.x]], paste0("TE: ", .x))) %>%
  list_rbind() %>%
  bind_rows(full_model_diagnostics(m_si, "SI: bivariate"))

write_csv(model_diagnostics_main, "../output/model_diagnostics_main.csv")
```

```{r ppc-stat-SI}
# Posterior predictive checks
set.seed(42)

row_skewness <- function(m) {
  xc <- m - rowMeans(m)
  rowMeans(xc^3) / (rowMeans(xc^2))^(3/2)
}
skewness <- function(x) {
  xc <- x - mean(x)
  mean(xc^3) / mean(xc^2)^(3/2)
}

isotopes_si <- c("d13C", "d15N")

rep_si <- isotopes_si %>%
  map(function(iso) posterior_predict(m_si, resp = iso)) %>%
  set_names(isotopes_si)

skew_obs_si <- isotopes_si %>%
  map_dbl(~ row_skewness(matrix(brm_dat_si[[.x]], nrow = 1))) %>%
  set_names(isotopes_si)
skew_rep_si <- isotopes_si %>%
  map(~ row_skewness(rep_si[[.x]])) %>%
  set_names(isotopes_si)

ppc_stat_si <- isotopes_si %>%
  map(function(iso) {
    obs <- brm_dat_si[[iso]]
    rep_mat <- rep_si[[iso]]

    skew_obs <- skew_obs_si[[iso]]
    skew_rep <- skew_rep_si[[iso]]
    iqr_obs <- IQR(obs)
    iqr_rep <- apply(rep_mat, 1, IQR)

    tibble(isotope = iso,
           stat = c("skewness", "IQR"),
           T_obs = c(skew_obs, iqr_obs),
           bayesian_p = c(mean(skew_rep > skew_obs, na.rm = TRUE),
                          mean(iqr_rep > iqr_obs, na.rm = TRUE)),
           n_excluded_nonfinite = c(sum(!is.finite(skew_rep)), sum(!is.finite(iqr_rep))))
  }) %>%
  list_rbind()
```

```{r emm-SI-euclid}
# Euclidean distance between fitted (d13C, d15N) for each colony pair
# Credibility tested using the Mahalanobis distance of the difference to the NULL difference (0,0)

si_draws <- brm_dat_si %>%
  data_grid(source) %>%
  add_epred_draws(m_si) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(source, .draw),
              names_from = .category,
              values_from = .epred)

colony_pairs <- combn(levels(brm_dat_si$source), 2, simplify = FALSE)

euclid_dist_si <- colony_pairs %>%
  map(function(pair) {
    d_a <- si_draws %>% filter(source == pair[1]) %>% arrange(.draw)
    d_b <- si_draws %>% filter(source == pair[2]) %>% arrange(.draw)
    diff_d13C <- d_a$d13C - d_b$d13C
    diff_d15N <- d_a$d15N - d_b$d15N
    dist <- sqrt(diff_d13C^2 + diff_d15N^2)

    diff_mat <- cbind(diff_d13C, diff_d15N)
    mahal_sq <- mahalanobis(matrix(0, nrow = 1, ncol = 2),
                             center = colMeans(diff_mat),
                             cov = cov(diff_mat))

    median_qi(dist, .width = 0.95) %>%
      transmute(contrast = paste(pair[1], "-", pair[2]),
                median_dist = y,
                lower = ymin,
                upper = ymax,
                mahalanobis_sq = mahal_sq,
                sig = as.integer(mahal_sq > qchisq(0.95, df = 2)))
  }) %>%
  list_rbind()

euclid_dist_si

write_csv(euclid_dist_si, "../output/emmeans_euclid_dist_si.csv")
```

```{r ppc-stat-SI-year-sensitivity}
set.seed(42)

rep_si_yr <- isotopes_si %>%
  map(function(iso) posterior_predict(m_si_yr, resp = iso)) %>%
  set_names(isotopes_si)

ppc_stat_si_yr <- isotopes_si %>%
  map(function(iso) {
    obs <- m_si_yr$data[[iso]]
    rep_mat <- rep_si_yr[[iso]]

    skew_obs <- row_skewness(matrix(obs, nrow = 1))
    skew_rep <- row_skewness(rep_mat)
    iqr_obs <- IQR(obs)
    iqr_rep <- apply(rep_mat, 1, IQR)

    tibble(isotope = iso,
           stat = c("skewness", "IQR"),
           T_obs = c(skew_obs, iqr_obs),
           bayesian_p = c(mean(skew_rep > skew_obs, na.rm = TRUE),
                          mean(iqr_rep > iqr_obs, na.rm = TRUE)),
           n_excluded_nonfinite = c(sum(!is.finite(skew_rep)), sum(!is.finite(iqr_rep))))
  }) %>%
  list_rbind()

ppc_stat_si_yr

write_csv(ppc_stat_si_yr, "../output/ppc_stat_si_yr.csv")
```

```{r emm-SI-euclid-year-sensitivity}
si_draws_yr <- brm_dat_si_yr %>%
  data_grid(source, year) %>%
  add_epred_draws(m_si_yr) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(source, .draw, .category) %>%
  summarise(.epred = mean(.epred), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(source, .draw),
              names_from = .category,
              values_from = .epred)

colony_pairs_yr <- combn(levels(brm_dat_si_yr$source), 2, simplify = FALSE)

euclid_dist_si_yr <- colony_pairs_yr %>%
  map(function(pair) {
    d_a <- si_draws_yr %>% filter(source == pair[1]) %>% arrange(.draw)
    d_b <- si_draws_yr %>% filter(source == pair[2]) %>% arrange(.draw)
    diff_d13C <- d_a$d13C - d_b$d13C
    diff_d15N <- d_a$d15N - d_b$d15N
    dist <- sqrt(diff_d13C^2 + diff_d15N^2)

    diff_mat <- cbind(diff_d13C, diff_d15N)
    mahal_sq <- mahalanobis(matrix(0, nrow = 1, ncol = 2),
                             center = colMeans(diff_mat),
                             cov = cov(diff_mat))

    median_qi(dist, .width = 0.95) %>%
      transmute(contrast = paste(pair[1], "-", pair[2]),
                median_dist = y,
                lower = ymin,
                upper = ymax,
                mahalanobis_sq = mahal_sq,
                sig_yr = as.integer(mahal_sq > qchisq(0.95, df = 2)))
  }) %>%
  list_rbind()

write_csv(euclid_dist_si_yr, "../output/emmeans_euclid_dist_si_year_sensitivity.csv")

si_euclid_year_sensitivity_comparison <- euclid_dist_si %>%
  filter(contrast %in% unique(euclid_dist_si_yr$contrast)) %>%
  select(contrast, sig) %>%
  rename(sig_main = sig) %>%
  inner_join(euclid_dist_si_yr %>% select(contrast, sig_yr), by = "contrast") %>%
  mutate(changed = sig_main != sig_yr)

si_euclid_year_sensitivity_comparison

write_csv(si_euclid_year_sensitivity_comparison, "../output/si_euclid_year_sensitivity_comparison.csv")
```

```{r export-tables-for-ms}
# Generates Tables 2-5 (manuscript) and S2-S5 (SI) as individual Word
# documents, written to ../output/tables/, directly from the fitted models
# and derived objects above
TABLES_DIR <- "../output/tables"
.ml <- "␞" 

fmt_tiered <- function(x) ifelse(abs(x) < 10, sprintf("%.2f", x), sprintf("%.1f", x))
fmt2 <- function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)
fmt3 <- function(x) sprintf("%.3f", x)
fmt_emm <- function(est, lo, hi, fmt = fmt_tiered) {
  paste0(fmt(est), .ml, "[", fmt(lo), "; ", fmt(hi), "]")
}

iso_labels <- c(d13C = "δ13C", d15N = "δ15N")

split_multiline_cells <- function(doc) {
  xml_doc <- doc$doc_obj$get()
  ns <- xml_ns(xml_doc)
  body <- xml_find_first(xml_doc, ".//w:body", ns)
  tbls <- xml_find_all(body, ".//w:tbl", ns)
  tbl <- tbls[[length(tbls)]]
  for (row in xml_find_all(tbl, "./w:tr", ns)) {
    for (cell in xml_find_all(row, "./w:tc", ns)) {
      p <- xml_find_first(cell, "./w:p", ns)
      full_text <- xml_text(p)
      if (grepl(.ml, full_text, fixed = TRUE)) {
        parts <- strsplit(full_text, .ml, fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
        run <- xml_find_first(p, ".//w:r", ns)
        rpr <- xml_find_first(run, "./w:rPr", ns)
        rpr_xml <- if (!is.na(rpr)) as.character(rpr) else ""
        t_node <- xml_find_first(p, ".//w:t", ns)
        xml_text(t_node) <- parts[1]
        prev <- p
        for (part in parts[-1]) {
          new_p <- read_xml(paste0(
            '<w:p xmlns:w="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main">',
            '<w:r>', rpr_xml, '<w:t xml:space="preserve">', part, '</w:t></w:r></w:p>'))
          prev <- xml_add_sibling(prev, new_p, where = "after")  
        }
      }
    }
  }
  doc
}

write_table_docx <- function(df, filename, title) {
  doc <- read_docx()
  doc <- body_add_par(doc, title, style = "heading 1")
  doc <- body_add_table(doc, as.data.frame(df), style = "Table Professional", first_row = TRUE)
  doc <- split_multiline_cells(doc)
  print(doc, target = file.path(TABLES_DIR, filename))
}

## ---- Table 2 ----
dp_lookup <- c(As = 2, Cd = 2, Co = 2, Cu = 2, Hg = 2, Mn = 2, Pb = 2, V = 2,
               Zn = 1, d13C = 1, d15N = 1) # decimal points
colonies_t2 <- c("Kent", "Country", "Middle Lawn", "Gull", "Baccalieu", "Iceland")

## For censored cells, mean/SD use the Kaplan-Meier estimator (NADA::cenfit)
km_mean_sd <- function(conc, bdt) {
  fit <- NADA::cenfit(conc, bdt)
  tibble(mean = unname(mean(fit)["mean"]), sd = sd(fit))
}

te_summary_t2 <- brm_dat %>%
  group_by(source, element) %>%
  reframe({
    ms <- km_mean_sd(conc, BDT)
    tibble(mean = ms$mean, sd = ms$sd, min = min(conc), max = max(conc),
           n = n(), n_cens = sum(BDT))
  })

si_summary_t2 <- brm_dat_si %>%
  pivot_longer(c(d13C, d15N), names_to = "element", values_to = "conc") %>%
  group_by(source, element) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(conc), sd = sd(conc), min = min(conc), max = max(conc),
            n = n(), n_cens = 0L, .groups = "drop")

t2_all <- bind_rows(te_summary_t2, si_summary_t2)

t2_cell <- function(el, src) {
  d <- t2_all %>% filter(element == el, source == src)
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return("NA")
  dp <- dp_lookup[[el]]
  f <- function(x) sprintf(paste0("%.", dp, "f"), x)
  paste0(f(d$mean), " ± ", f(d$sd), .ml,
         "[", f(d$min), ", ", f(d$max), "]", .ml,
         "(", d$n, "; ", d$n_cens, ")")
}

table2 <- c(elements_te_tab, "d13C", "d15N") %>%
  map(function(el) {
    vals <- setNames(colonies_t2 %>% map_chr(~ t2_cell(el, .x)), colonies_t2)
    label <- if (el %in% names(iso_labels)) unname(iso_labels[el]) else el
    c(Parameter = label, vals)
  }) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  rename(Vestmannaeyjar = Iceland)

write_table_docx(table2, "table2.docx",
  "Table 2. Mean ± SD [range] (sample size; number censored, i.e. below the limit of quantification) of trace element (TE) concentrations (µg/g) and stable isotope values (‰). For colony-element combinations with censored observations, mean and SD were estimated with the nonparametric Kaplan-Meier method for left-censored data (Helsel, 2011). Vestmannaeyjar is the Icelandic colony; all others are Canadian.")

## ---- Table 3 ----
colonies_t3 <- c("Kent", "Country", "Middle Lawn", "Gull", "Baccalieu", "Iceland")

table3_te <- elements_te_tab %>%
  map(function(el) {
    em <- as.data.frame(emmeans(m_elem[[el]], ~ source)) %>%
      mutate(source = factor(as.character(source), levels = colonies_t3))
    vals <- setNames(
      fmt_emm(exp(em$emmean), exp(em$lower.QL), exp(em$upper.QL)),
      as.character(em$source)
    )

  }) %>%

  c(Parameter = unname(iso_labels["d13C"]),
    setNames(fmt_emm(em_si_d13C$emmean, em_si_d13C$lower.QL, em_si_d13C$upper.QL),

  d <- model_diagnostics_main %>% filter(model == paste0("TE: ", el))
  c(Model = el,
    `R-hat range` = paste0(fmt3(d$min_rhat), "; ", fmt3(d$max_rhat)),
    `Bulk-ESS range` = paste0(d$min_ess_bulk, "; ", d$max_ess_bulk),

    Divergences = as.character(d$n_divergent),

    `Skewness p` = fmt2(d$skewness_p_min),
    `IQR p` = fmt2(d$IQR_p_min))
}

  mutate(element = as.character(element)) %>%
  rename(Element = element) %>%
  select(Element, any_of(colonies_t2[colonies_t2 != "Iceland"])) %>%
  mutate(across(-Element, ~ replace_na(., "-")))

write_table_docx(table_s4_loq, "tableS4.docx",
  "Table S4. Median limit of quantification (LOQ) by trace element and colony, among censored (below-LOQ) observations only (n = number of censored observations at that colony). Iceland, Cu, Hg and Zn had no censored observations and are omitted.")

## ---- Table S5 ----
s5_row <- function(el) {
  d <- model_diagnostics_sensitivity %>% filter(model == paste0("TE yr: ", el))
  skew_p <- ppc_stat_te_yr %>% filter(element == el, stat == "skewness") %>% pull(bayesian_p)
  iqr_p  <- ppc_stat_te_yr %>% filter(element == el, stat == "IQR") %>% pull(bayesian_p)
  c(Model = el,
    `R-hat range` = paste0(fmt3(d$min_rhat), "; ", fmt3(d$max_rhat)),
    `Bulk-ESS range` = paste0(d$min_ess_bulk, "; ", d$max_ess_bulk),
    `Tail-ESS range` = paste0(d$min_ess_tail, "; ", d$max_ess_tail),
    Divergences = as.character(d$n_divergent),
    `Max tree depth (limit)` = paste0(d$max_treedepth, " (", d$treedepth_limit, ")"),
    `Min E-BFMI` = fmt_tiered(d$min_ebfmi),
    `Pareto-k (n > 0.7)` = paste0(fmt_tiered(d$max_pareto_k), " (", d$n_pareto_k_gt_0.7, ")"),
    `Skewness p` = fmt_tiered(skew_p),
    `IQR p` = fmt_tiered(iqr_p))
}

d_si_s5 <- model_diagnostics_sensitivity %>% filter(model == "SI yr: bivariate")
skew_d13c <- ppc_stat_si_yr %>% filter(isotope == "d13C", stat == "skewness") %>% pull(bayesian_p)
skew_d15n <- ppc_stat_si_yr %>% filter(isotope == "d15N", stat == "skewness") %>% pull(bayesian_p)
iqr_d13c  <- ppc_stat_si_yr %>% filter(isotope == "d13C", stat == "IQR") %>% pull(bayesian_p)
iqr_d15n  <- ppc_stat_si_yr %>% filter(isotope == "d15N", stat == "IQR") %>% pull(bayesian_p)

s5_si_row <- c(Model = paste0("SI (", iso_labels["d13C"], " & ", iso_labels["d15N"], ")"),
  `R-hat range` = paste0(fmt3(d_si_s5$min_rhat), "; ", fmt3(d_si_s5$max_rhat)),
  `Bulk-ESS range` = paste0(d_si_s5$min_ess_bulk, "; ", d_si_s5$max_ess_bulk),
  `Tail-ESS range` = paste0(d_si_s5$min_ess_tail, "; ", d_si_s5$max_ess_tail),
  Divergences = as.character(d_si_s5$n_divergent),
  `Max tree depth (limit)` = paste0(d_si_s5$max_treedepth, " (", d_si_s5$treedepth_limit, ")"),
  `Min E-BFMI` = fmt_tiered(d_si_s5$min_ebfmi),
  `Pareto-k (n > 0.7)` = paste0(fmt_tiered(d_si_s5$max_pareto_k), " (", d_si_s5$n_pareto_k_gt_0.7, ")"),
  `Skewness p` = paste0(fmt_tiered(skew_d13c), "-", fmt_tiered(skew_d15n)),
  `IQR p` = paste0(fmt_tiered(iqr_d13c), "-", fmt_tiered(iqr_d15n)))

table_s5 <- bind_rows(intersect(elements_te_tab, elements_te_yr) %>% map(s5_row), s5_si_row)
write_table_docx(table_s5, "tableS5.docx",
  "Table S5. Model performance checks table for the sensitivity models (Country/Gull/Kent, year as a fixed effect). For each trace element an individual Bayesian linear model (LM) was fit, while for the stable isotopes (SI) a bivariate model was fit.")

## ---- Table S6 ----
table_s6 <- bind_rows(
  te_year_sensitivity_comparison %>%
    mutate(element = factor(element, levels = elements_te_tab)) %>%
    arrange(element) %>%
    transmute(Analyte = as.character(element), Contrast = contrast,
              `Different (main)` = sig_main, `Different (year-adjusted)` = sig_yr, Changed = changed),
  si_year_sensitivity_comparison %>%
    transmute(Analyte = isotope, Contrast = contrast,
              `Different (main)` = sig_main, `Different (year-adjusted)` = sig_yr, Changed = changed),
  si_euclid_year_sensitivity_comparison %>%
    transmute(Analyte = "Joint SI", Contrast = contrast,
              `Different (main)` = sig_main, `Different (year-adjusted)` = sig_yr, Changed = changed)
) %>%
  mutate(across(c(`Different (main)`, `Different (year-adjusted)`, Changed), as.character))
write_table_docx(table_s6, "tableS6.docx",
  "Table S6. Comparison of colony-pairwise credibility calls between the main models (Table S3) and the year-adjusted sensitivity models, for each trace element and stable isotope value.")
```
